info.title: Office Workspace Backend Contract
info.description: Phase 00 contract, approved D-01–D-11. P1 operations are reserved and gated until Phase 09.

servers.description: Same-origin API base; deployment host is environment-specific

Set-Cookie.description: Rotating refresh cookie; HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/api/auth, Max-Age=604800

post.description: Rotates 7-day HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax refresh cookie; returns a new 15-minute access token. Invalid/expired cookies are cleared.
Revoke all refresh sessions for the current user.

get.description: MANAGER may browse all account statuses and receives safe admin DTOs. DEPUTY_MANAGER receives active-directory DTOs. STAFF receives the active directory projection only. LOCKED is not enumerable to non-Managers.

post.description: MANAGER only. If initialPassword is omitted, one generated temporary password is returned once.

get.description: Manager receives the safe admin DTO; other roles receive active-directory projection. LOCKED users are hidden from non-Managers.

patch.description: MANAGER only; role/status/email changes revoke sessions. A transaction lock protects the final ACTIVE Manager; self-lock is denied.

post.description: MANAGER only; temporary password is returned once and must not be logged. All existing sessions are revoked.

get.description: MANAGER/DEPUTY_MANAGER can inspect all users; STAFF only self. Filters task createdAt in UTC.
ACL is applied before filtering and total counting.

post.description: MANAGER/DEPUTY_MANAGER create an OFFICIAL DRAFT. TEAM/PERSONAL variants open in Phase 09.

patch.description: DRAFT creator-leader or leader on an active published OFFICIAL task. No status, due date or assignee change through PATCH.

post.description: TEAM/PERSONAL IN_PROGRESS to DONE by creator/current assignee; no approval record.
DRAFT to TODO; creator must be a leader; title, deliverable, active assignee and due date are required.
TODO to IN_PROGRESS; leader or current assignee.
TODO/IN_PROGRESS only; 100 percent does not mark DONE.
Leader-only direct due date, assignee or priority change with reason.
Reason required; an IN_REVIEW task closes its pending submission as WITHDRAWN and retains prior history.
D-09 transition and history retention.
Current assignee in IN_PROGRESS only; every submit creates a distinct submission record whose decision status is retained in history.
Only submitter of current PENDING submission.
MANAGER/DEPUTY_MANAGER; submissionId must be current PENDING.
MANAGER/DEPUTY_MANAGER; nonblank reason required.
Requires read access to an active published OFFICIAL task. DONE and CANCELLED remain readable but cannot receive comments.

Checks current write ACL, 20 MB default limit, MIME/extension allowlist and creates UPLOADING metadata. Task attachments are staged on TASK and moved to SUBMISSION on submit. Never accepts uploadedById or objectKey.
HEAD/size/type/checksum verification before READY.

get.description: ACL is applied to the linked task before filtering, counting and pagination. MESSAGE opens in P1.
Rechecks entity ACL; REMOVED files return 404.

delete.description: Soft REMOVED; object cleanup after 90 days if no valid links.

get.description: Returns the caller's notifications only. Without after, results are newest-first; with after, results are ascending to replay missed notifications. Current task ACL is reapplied and inaccessible task content is generalized.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Exclusive createdAt/id cursor for reconnect; results are ascending.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Exclusive createdAt/id cursor for older pages; cannot be combined with after.

post.description: Only the recipient can mark this notification read.

get.description: DEPT returns ManagerDashboardStats to leaders; STAFF returns StaffDashboardStats for self. Every filter is applied before aggregation. See oneOf schema override below.
Scope DEPT for leaders; STAFF receives own report only. Same filters/formulas as dashboard and export.
Leader-only binary export; content is CSV or XLSX. Response envelope does not apply to binary.
MANAGER only; separate from task timeline.
MANAGER only. Metadata of latest backup/restore drill; no raw dump or signed URL.
MANAGER-only operational counters, memory, DB connections, KPI latency and backup status; counters are per instance and reset on restart.

delete.description: Soft archive; tasks retain project history and ACL.

get.description: Array envelope; filters task ACL before projection.

error.message: Trạng thái nhiệm vụ đã thay đổi

DirectoryUser.description: Safe active-directory projection; excludes account status, role, last login and management data.

FileObject.description: R2 objectKey is server-only and never included in public responses.

Notification.description: Recipient-only projection. If current task ACL no longer allows access, taskId is null and title/body are generalized.

BackupStatus.description: No object key, signed URL, DB dump or credentials.

cpuUsage.description: Process CPU time since the previous operations snapshot, normalized to one CPU core.

kpiQueryLatencyMs.description: p95 is computed over the most recent bounded window of at most 512 KPI observations.

OperationsMetrics.description: MANAGER-only instance snapshot; counters reset at process restart. Contains no object keys or credentials.

CreateUserResult.description: temporaryPassword appears only when the server generated it and is returned once.

UserWorkloadStats.description: fromDate/toDate filter task createdAt in UTC. Primary metrics use valid OFFICIAL tasks; collabCount also includes accepted TEAM collaborators, excluding primary assignments.

TaskDetail.description: Histories are fetched through paginated subresource endpoints.

password.description: Password is subject to the bcrypt 72-byte UTF-8 input limit.

currentPassword.description: Password is subject to the bcrypt 72-byte UTF-8 input limit.

newPassword.description: Password is subject to the bcrypt 72-byte UTF-8 input limit.

initialPassword.description: Password is subject to the bcrypt 72-byte UTF-8 input limit.

newPassword.description: Password is subject to the bcrypt 72-byte UTF-8 input limit.

CreateTaskInput.description: P0 accepts OFFICIAL only and creates DRAFT. dueAt and dueDate are mutually exclusive; DRAFT may omit assignment/due date. Non-null projectId/parentTaskId open in P1.

UpdateTaskInput.description: No status, dueAt, assignee or server fields. Priority may change only while DRAFT; published task priority uses /adjust in Phase 04. projectId opens in P1.

ProgressInput.description: A nonblank blockedReason is required when isBlocked is true; 100 percent does not complete the task.

AdjustTaskInput.description: At least one mutable field; dueAt and dueDate are mutually exclusive. A nonblank reason is required.

SubmitTaskInput.description: Every fileId must be a READY file currently linked to this task.

CommentInput.description: Nonblank text on an active published OFFICIAL task.

UploadUrlInput.description: P0 task files are staged on TASK before submission; COMMENT attachments target the comment. Backend validates the declared size, MIME and filename before issuing a short-lived signed PUT URL. MESSAGE opens in P1.

x-socket-events.sourceOfTruth: REST and durable DB records; rooms are server ACL checked
